pages.title: Special Delivery
pages.text: Deliver a filled Package by Chain Conveyor to a receiving Frogport.

pages.title: Special Delivery
pages.text: Give the shipment a real destination; spare packaging supports the next delivery.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Connect compatible sending and receiving points using the native conveyor setup. Credit occurs when the receiving port accepts the carried package.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Put an address sign on the Packager and use address-aware routing components. Label outgoing packages for their intended destination.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Connect Frogports to a Chain Conveyor network and assign addresses. Route packages to matching ports; unmatched packages wait on the network.
